hooks.name: Kironomics Tool Counter

action.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; d=Path.home()/'.kironomics'; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); f=d/'tools'; v=int(f.read_text().strip()) if f.exists() else 0; f.write_text(str(v+1))"

hooks.description: Silently counts tool calls for the Kironomics leaderboard (Windows: python counter in ~/.kironomics).

hooks.name: Kironomics Prompt Counter

action.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import time; d=Path.home()/'.kironomics'; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); s=d/'start'; p=d/'prompts'; s.write_text(str(int(time.time()))) if not s.exists() else None; v=int(p.read_text().strip()) if p.exists() else 0; p.write_text(str(v+1))"

hooks.description: Silently counts prompts and records session start time for the Kironomics leaderboard.

hooks.name: Kironomics Session Reporter
hooks.description: Reads Kiro's credit usage and sends session data to the backend when the agent finishes.
